description: Create a temporary inbox for an authorized development or QA workflow. Return its address, access token, and expiry; the token is required to read it.

prefix.description: Optional custom prefix (e.g. "myagent_99"): 4-32 ASCII characters with a digit and an internal -, _ or .; official and common role names are reserved. If omitted, a random address is generated.

name: gecici_create_inbox
title: Create temporary test inbox
